items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 123:1
items.html: In the third aspect of the world of Assiyah, when even the six lower ones of Assiyah ascended to the place of the Nukva of Atzilut, then Assiyah turned her face opposite the face of Yetzirah, face to face, like ZON face to face. (Item 87).
